findings.criterion: inbound DC assignee mutations MINT AN IDENTITY SUCCESSFULLY — asserted positively (the identity exists and carries the jira family), NOT merely that no exception escaped
findings.detail: No test calling `rebar.ensure_identity_for("jira", <dc_user_name>, <display_name>)` and asserting (a) the returned id equals the local ticket's `.assignee` and (b) the provider is the family string `"jira"` was found anywhere in `tests/external/live_jira_dc/`. Searches for `ensure_identity_for`, `identity_family`, and `jira family` all returned no matches. The transport test `test_name_identity_user_search_resolves_a_real_user_authoritatively` exists but does not assert the identity-minting outcome the AC requires.

findings.criterion: every mutation in the suite above round-trips and is asserted INDIVIDUALLY (never by an aggregate 'converged' line), against the named observable — the full 14-inbound × 14-outbound table
findings.detail: `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py` is absent from the repository. The plan-review signature explicitly records `dep absent tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py`. The ticket's `file_impact` lists this file as required. Only the thin vertical slice (one inbound create + one outbound title edit) exists in `test_store_copy_isolation.py`; the remaining 26 of 28 mutation cells (rows 2-14 inbound and rows 2-14 outbound) are not implemented.

citations.description: search_files for 'idempotence' in tests/external/live_jira_dc returned only the test_reconcile_pass.py docstring reference, not a per-mutation assertion

findings.criterion: a repeated pass after each direction writes nothing (idempotence) — per-mutation, after each direction
findings.detail: The idempotence test `test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing` in `test_reconcile_pass.py` runs against an empty `dc_rebar_repo` (initialized via `rebar.init_repo()` on a temp dir), not against the real store copy and not per-mutation. The AC requires idempotence to be asserted after each direction in the comprehensive mutation suite, which does not exist. No idempotence assertion is present in `test_store_copy_isolation.py`.

findings.criterion: this project's live Jira is untouched, asserted as a FILE-CONTENT check — collects every base_url assignment in the working repo's config files and asserts the SET of distinct values is exactly {the harness URL}
findings.detail: No test performing this file-content check was found. The AC requires a test (not a CI step) that reads `rebar.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, and any `.rebar/*` config file in the working repo, collects all `base_url` assignments, and asserts the set equals `{"http://localhost:2990/jira"}`. Searches for 'distinct values', 'harness URL', 'untouched', 'file-content', and 'collect every' returned no matches. The `rebar.toml` written by the fixture does contain the harness URL, but no test reads it back and asserts the set.
